    "The locking nuts felt useful alongside my recent fastening supplies because they could support projects needing secure bolted connections.",

    "My purchases of nails and screws seemed to be treated as interest in almost any workshop or repair supply.",
    "A connection to vacuum cleaning seemed to outweigh the difference between replacing consumables and replacing the appliance."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My repeated purchases of framing nails and wood screws make fastening work a stronger current interest than unrelated plumbing or metal fabrication tasks.",
    "Specific uses and compatibility matter: pocket-hole screws need a suitable project, and locking nuts need matching bolts.",
    "I choose supplies for a present need, so general usefulness alone does not make specialized products or large packs appealing."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations partly recognized my fastening needs but stretched that interest into unrelated workshop tasks and an unnecessary vacuum replacement."
}
